query: Send the master a question while the operator is away.
expected_behavior: Load the toolbelt reference for the inbox
Run agentihooks msg send master@<slug> with the question
Never write the question to the ledger or the operator first

query: My task is waiting on its pull request in the merge queue.
expected_behavior: Find the swarm wait trigger in the reference
Declare agentihooks swarm <slug> wait --on merge <pr url>
Keep the wait until the pull request merges or leaves the queue

query: A QUOTA HANDOFF REQUIRED directive arrived.
expected_behavior: Write the handoff document at the given path and run the given init-agent --handoff command
Report where the work moved and stop

query: Which layer injected this wrong directive into my session?
expected_behavior: Use agentihooks trace with the session id
Clear it at its source through trace sweep, never by hand

query: A QUOTA WAIT directive arrived in a swarm session.
expected_behavior: Run the given agentihooks swarm wait with the reset time in its reason
Repeat bounded waits until the reset instead of creating a session cron

query: A QUOTA WAIT directive arrived outside a swarm.
expected_behavior: Run the given agentihooks timer add command with an absolute reset time and the existing session target
Stop until the scheduler wakes this session instead of creating a session cron
